proj_asean_desc: As part of the ASEAN Data 2024 initiative, I collaborated on a research project focusing on strategies to reduce carbon emissions across ASEAN through accelerated electric vehicle adoption.
proj_asean_desc2: The project positions sustainable transportation as a key driver for climate mitigation, public health, and regional economic development — aligned with UN SDG 13: Climate Action.
proj_asean_c1: Conducted data collection and analysis on environmental and transportation trends across ASEAN countries.
proj_asean_c2: Identified and validated credible data sources to support research accuracy and insights.
proj_asean_c3: Extracted actionable insights to evaluate emission patterns and mobility trends.
proj_asean_c4: Contributed to project direction and topic alignment with UN SDG 13.
proj_asean_f1: Regional carbon emission levels and transportation trends.
proj_asean_f2: Feasibility and scalability of EV adoption and production in ASEAN.
proj_asean_f3: Government policies, infrastructure readiness, and cross-border collaboration.
proj_asean_f4: Long-term benefits of EVs — improved air quality and reduced fossil fuel dependency.
proj_asean_impact: Developed as a strategic communication tool for policymakers, industry stakeholders, and the public — combining data-driven analysis with clear narrative storytelling.
